title: Refactor ObjectUI to support modular plugin architecture and dynamic management
body:
# Refactor ObjectUI for Plugin Modularity and Dynamic Management

After an in-depth analysis of the current codebase and configuration merging logic, several architectural and development details require improvement to support true modular development, plugin isolation, and dynamic plugin install/uninstall at runtime.

## Current Shortcomings
- All example apps (CRM, Todo, Kitchen Sink) are merged into a single `mergedApp` definition at the repository root, causing:
  - Loss of plugin/module boundaries (no identity per App/Plugin)
  - No ability to install/uninstall modules at runtime
  - Manual maintenance for each new plugin (non-scalable)
  - Lack of standardized plugin lifecycle (init/start/stop)
- No formalized kernel-based plugin registry (like `kernel.use(plugin)`)
- Difficult to use ObjectUI as a host for third-party (or cross-repo) plugins
- Hard to upgrade example apps independently or share/reuse their config in other ObjectStack projects
- The merging approach limits custom configuration per app/plugin (e.g. i18n, permissions, datastores)

## Actionable Improvements
1. **Define a Plugin Class Standard**
   - Each app/example and plugin should export a `Plugin` class (with `init`, `start`, `stop`, `name`, `version`, `description`, etc.)
   - Example: `export class CRMPlugin { ... }`, `export class KanbanPlugin { ... }`
2. **Refactor Root `objectstack.config.ts`**
   - Remove the static merge logic and aggregation functions
   - Load plugins modularly: `plugins: [new CRMPlugin(), new KanbanPlugin(), ...]`
   - Plugins should register themselves with the kernel (ObjectStack runtime) at startup
3. **Enable Dynamic Plugin Loading**
   - Refactor runtime to allow `install(plugin)` and `uninstall(plugin)` at runtime (not just compile-time)
   - Enable hot-reload or lazy loading of plugins for development and production
4. **Preserve Plugin Identity**
   - Ensure each object, action, dashboard, etc. keeps its origin plugin metadata for runtime inspection/debugging
   - Support per-plugin i18n, permissions, data isolation
5. **Make Example Apps True Plugins**
   - Refactor `/examples/crm`, `/examples/todo`, `/examples/kitchen-sink` to export plugin classes, not just flat config objects
   - Remove merge-based dependency; instead, let host choose what to load
6. **Plugin Lifecycle Hooks**
   - All plugins should support `init`, `start`, `stop`, and allow async setup/teardown
   - Host can call these hooks when loading/unloading
7. **Docs & Roadmap**
   - Update documentation to explain plugin model, architecture, and runtime API
   - Update ROADMAP.md to track plugin modularization progress and dynamic runtime features
8. **Backward Compatibility**
   - Provide clear migration paths for old app config merging to new plugin paradigm
   - Support legacy config for transition

---

**Cross-repo Follow-up:** If dynamic plugin registry requires changes in ObjectStack runtime/core, create a cross-repo issue in [`objectstack-ai/objectstack`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack).

**Tests & Docs:** After implementation, update unit tests and Storybook, and refactor documentation accordingly.

---
**References:**
- See HotCRM plugin architecture and plugin.ts class pattern for best practices.
- [Current CRM plugin pattern](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/main/examples/crm/plugin.ts)
- [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/main/ROADMAP.md)
